outcome: composite respiratory outcome (defined as the need for respiratory support by 72 hours of age)
cohort: The study included late preterm infants (34 0/7-36 6/7 weeks' gestational age) from multiple gestations born between January 2013 and December 2022.
finding: Any antenatal steroid exposure in late preterm multiple gestation infants was associated with a significantly lower risk of composite respiratory outcome.
